strengthened_claims: next_system extends any funded History by one mandatory SYSTEM Θ invocation via Trace.system, preserving receipts/blocks/credits/counts exactly.
next_transfer extends any funded History by one bare protocol-level transfer via Trace.transfer, preserving the same seven fields.

Both non-receipt extensions leave receipts, blocks, baseCredits, credits, pow, withdrawals, migrations and counts literally unchanged; the six stability lemmas expose this shape without pattern matching.
eliminated_inputs: The previous requirement for a caller to unfold History and hand-assemble the SYSTEM Θ or transfer path when only the pre-world needed to change.

domain.trust: Canonical Ethereum production of the SYSTEM authorization and the transfer scheduling remain distinct obligations named in ReferenceCanonicalHooks.
